dkim.description: DKIM verification result reported for the message.

dkim-domain.description: Domain that signed the message with DKIM.

dkim-record.description: Published DKIM key TXT record, including an empty p= for revoked keys; not a message signature.

dkim-selector.description: DKIM selector queried beneath _domainkey at domain.

dkim-signature.description: DKIM signature as recorded by the source.

dmarc.description: DMARC evaluation result reported for the message.

dmarc-override.description: Source-reported override action for the DMARC result.

dmarc-policy.description: DMARC policy status or disposition supplied by the source.

dmarc-record.description: Published DMARC TXT record; not a message evaluation result.

dns-name.description: DNS name queried for this TXT record.

dns-owner.description: Owner of the returned TXT record, which may differ from dns-name when an alias is followed.

dns-ttl.description: Time to live in seconds of the returned TXT record.

domain.description: Domain whose published email-authentication configuration was queried.

spf.description: SPF evaluation result reported for the message.

spf-record.description: Published SPF TXT record, with DNS character-string chunks concatenated.

description: SPF, DKIM and DMARC results for one email observation, or one published email-authentication DNS record. DNS records describe configuration, not message verification results. Based on OCSF 1.9.0: https://schema.ocsf.io/1.9.0/objects/email_auth.
name: email-authentication
